changes.to: Issue #17 (2026-11-17): 5'8" (1727 mm), 61 kg, 20 kg payload, 1.2 m/s, 5 h runtime confirmed on figure.ai. HumanoidStore rows dropped.

Maker page figure.ai/figure (checked 2026-11-17): 5 ft 8 in (1727 mm), 61 kg, 20 kg payload, 5 h runtime, 1.2 m/s, electric. The 'Introducing Figure 03' release adds 2 kW wireless inductive charging through coils in the feet, 10 Gbps mmWave data offload, fingertip tactile sensors that resolve about 3 g, palm cameras, cameras with twice the frame rate, a quarter of the latency and 60% wider field of view than Figure 02, 9% less mass than Figure 02 and a UN 38.3 battery. DoF is not published by the maker, so it stays empty; no price is published.

changes.from: General-purpose humanoid aimed at the home and commercial work, built around Figure's Helix VLA model; 2 kW wireless foot charging. Height 5'8" converted.
changes.to: Figure's third-generation electric humanoid for household work, with tactile hands, palm cameras, inductive foot charging and a 5 h runtime.
